messages:
Lina K.: quick sync — following the cluster OOMs last night, I want a concise action roster for the KV residency leak and fragmentation follow-ups. we need owners + ETA by EOD.
Trevor M.: on it. I ran a quick alloc profile this morning, attached heap diff looked like large dormant shards retaining refs after compaction. will share flamegraph by noon. :clipboard:
Omar S.: can you paste the profiler commands you used? i want to re-run on the repro image.
Trevor M.: use `perf record -e cpu-clock -F 99 -- ./runtime --profile` then `perf script | flamegraph.pl > flame.svg`. also ran `jemalloc_stats` on the failing pod.
Sasha R.: FYI I enabled per-shard residency limits `--kv-max-residency=500MB` on the canary; metrics show drop in resident set but increased eviction churn. need to tune.
Lina K.: good. owners: Trevor = profiling + flamegraphs; Sasha = canary limits tuning; Omar = GC/alloc review + memhooks; Jae = telemetry and alert thresholds. pls confirm ETAs.
Trevor M.: ETA flamegraphs + initial hypothesis by 12:00 PST. will include sample stack traces and top offenders.
Sasha R.: can do limit tuning + two config variants today, ETA 17:00 PST. will post rollout notes and rollback plan.
Omar S.: I'll audit jemalloc config and GC triggers, propose changes (arena purge frequency, epoch) by 16:00 PST.
Jae: re thresholds: current OOM alert fires at pod restart count >3 in 10m. propose new early warning: RSS growth >20% in 5m for >3 pods. Can implement in grafana today.
Lina K.: add a short-run checklist for oncall: 1) scale-down canary, 2) enable debug malloc, 3) capture /proc/<pid>/smaps, 4) rotate logs. keep it tight.
Eva (infra-bot): deploy-bot: Canary config `kv-residency-v2` deployed to cluster-a (5 pods) at 08:12 UTC.
Trevor M.: observed pattern in stacks: repeated path through `kv::reserve_cached()` and `shard::deferred_free()` where refcount never drops. suspect missed decrement on error path.
Omar S.: that lines up with GC not reclaiming tombstones. will add defensive decref in the tombstone path and run unit tests.
Sasha R.: after limit change, eviction rate up x2 but tail latency unaffected. need to ensure QoS for hot keys. suggestion: exempt hot-set from residency limit via LRU sticky flag.
Jae: added new alert: `kv.rss_growth.v1` (expr: increase(kv_resident_bytes[5m]) > 0.2 * kv_resident_bytes) -> notify #eng-runtime. will PR shortly.
Lina K.: blockers?
Trevor M.: need a reproducible load fixture that exercises the deferred_free path. asking infra for a traffic replay of last-night window.
Sasha R.: need quick E2E test to ensure hot-key exemption doesn't create new mem spikes. can write a small harness, 2h.
Omar S.: tests pass locally after the decref patch, pushing to staging now.
Eva (infra-bot): CI: staging job 7892 started (kv-runtime-integ).
Lina K.: ok next steps: (1) Trevor finish flamegraphs + hypothesis (12:00 PST), (2) Omar PR for decref + jemalloc tweak (16:00 PST), (3) Sasha two config variants + harness (17:00 PST), (4) Jae alerts + dashboards (EOD). owners please update this thread when done.
Jae: will post dashboard links when grafana panels are up (ETA 18:00 PST).
Trevor M.: posted flamegraphs: https://internal/fg/2167348890 — main leak stack included.
Sasha R.: config PR opened: https://gh/redwood/infra/pull/482 — includes rollback steps.
Omar S.: PR for decref and jemalloc adjustments: https://gh/redwood/runtime/pull/214 — tests green in staging so far.
Lina K.: great. follow-ups for retrospec: track recurrence window, add synthetic nightly eviction test, and add regression eval to Redwood Optimize. i'll draft the postmortem follow-up doc tomorrow. :memo:
Trevor M.: noted. ping me if you need perf artifacts.
Sasha R.: will monitor canary for 24h and post metrics snapshot at 24h.
Jae: alert + dashboard PR: https://gh/redwood/observability/pull/109 — includes runbook steps.
Lina K.: thanks team. closing loop: update thread when your ETA is met and include short note (done/follow-up). :thumbsup:
